section_summary.extract_value: This section reports exploratory factor analysis (EFA) of the Portuguese SATAQ-3 (Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3) with 30 items, extracting four factors (Information, Internalisation-General, Pressures, and Internalisation-Athlete) with good internal consistency. Sex difference analyses using independent sample t-tests (N=311; women n=195, men n=116) revealed no significant differences on Information and Internalisation-Athlete subscales, but women scored significantly higher on Internalisation-General and Pressures subscales.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor analysis results for the Portuguese SATAQ-3 (Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3), which extracted four factors: Information, Internalisation-General, Pressures, and Internalisation-Athlete. Table 4 displays inter-scale correlations between the overall ACSS (Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale) score and all remaining variables, with correlations for women shown in the upper diagonal and men in the lower diagonal (n = 195 women, n = 116 men). Sex differences were found on Internalisation-General and Pressures subscales, with women scoring significantly higher than men on both.
